job.text: How many prospects reach each stage of the sales process, and where are most lost?

insight.important: Half the prospects who contacted support did not subscribe, the biggest loss between stages

title.text: Half of Those Who Contacted Support Did Not Subscribe

source.shows: the funnel's replacement (R12-5): the prospects at each stage as bars in stage order, and beneath them the % change from each stage to the next, each bar between the two stages it links; the values are the book's funnel labels (its bar version draws the last two stages and the third change differently, D-54)
